title: Technical Sales Engineer
company: Beta Elektroteknik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.
desc:
We are seeking highly motivated and customer-focused Technical Sales Engineers to strengthen Beta Elektroteknik's engagement with B2B customers across the market.
This role is responsible for managing a portfolio of machinery manufacturers, turn-key project developers, end users of related product range and developing strong customer relationships, and identifying opportunities to accelerate business growth through field sales activities.
Job Description
* Searching for new clients who could benefit from our products in a designated region
* Travelling to visit potential or exisiting clients
* Establishing new, and maintaining existing relationships with customers
* Managing and interpreting customer requirements
* Offering after-sales support services
* Preparing reports for head office
* Making technical presentations and demonstrating how a product will meet client needs
* Preparing reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing sales information and engineering and application trends.
Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in related departments from reputable universities; electrical/mechatronics/ automation engineering
* Experience as a sales engineer in industrial automation/electrical/energy management fields
* MS Office skills
* Excellent communication skills, oral and writing
* Good command of English
* No military obligation for male candidates
* Have no restriction to travel
* B type driving licence
